justifications.durability: The repair is committed on the run worktree across three mechanism-stated commits with no AI attribution and no plan identifier. The all-or-nothing rule is expressed once, in the statement, and the docstring is updated to match. Held below full because the default-gate test binds to the statement's spelling (substring matches on the guarded FOREACH form), so a future refactor of equivalent semantics would redden the test, and because the correctness rests on a Cypher guard whose behavioural proof is graph-gated.
justifications.evidence: The delta adds targeted tests and one live behavioural proof. tests/ids/test_candidates.py::test_section_prompt_lists_candidate_edge_dicts drives _prepare_section_context with edge-dict candidates including a None retrieval_score and None documentation, the exact shape that raised AttributeError before. tests/ids/test_candidate_persistence.py adds test_a_partial_pick_flags_no_edge_and_leaves_the_route, test_an_empty_pick_is_refused_with_no_query and test_a_duplicate_path_marks_one_edge, and c2c05d431 reorders the live round-trip so the refused partial pick runs before any successful pick, reading back every route false and candidate_route still escalated — a behavioural assertion, not a text one. Reproduced here: base arm 530 passed, 8 skipped, 2 deselected, EXIT=0; head arm 534 passed, 8 skipped, 2 deselected, EXIT=0; live graph arm at head 2 passed, EXIT=0. I also mutated the head guard (FOREACH (rel IN found | SET rel.route = true)) and reran the graph arm: test_read_and_select_candidates_round_trip fails 1 failed, 1 passed, EXIT=1, so the guard fires. Held below full because the partial-pick unit test asserts on the normalised query string (statement.count of the guarded FOREACH) as its default-gate proxy; the behavioural proof lives only in the @pytest.mark.graph test, excluded from the gate.
justifications.fit: The changed code stays in place: the pick marker sits beside write_candidates/read_candidates/clear_candidates in imas_codex/ids/graph_ops.py, seeds its readers from what gather_ids_context stores, and its docstring states the all-or-nothing reason. The removed compute_semantic_matches parameters are deleted from the signature and its single caller updated, and names remain mechanism-based (select_candidates, _prepare_section_context).
justifications.goal_fidelity: The delta closes both defects the prior review raised and brings the container change to completion at every consumer. _prepare_section_context (imas_codex/ids/mapping.py) now reads the read_candidates edge-dict shape (cand['path'] / cand.get('retrieval_score') / cand.get('documentation')), matching the map_signals consumer at :1038, so no reader of a source's source_candidates is left on the removed Candidate shape (grep source_candidates finds only read_candidates, the two dict consumers, and a len() in workers.py). select_candidates is now all-or-nothing: the edge flag and candidate_route are written only when every distinct listed path matched, an empty list is refused before any query, and duplicates are collapsed. Every §8 done-when item holds at head: read_candidates returns each source's edges with section, data_type, timebasepath and ndim; select_candidates marks exactly the listed edges, possibly across two IDSs; gather_ids_context reads from read_candidates and never calls retrieve_candidates; discover status reads the graph_ops.py route count; _candidate_records raises on an unmatched judgment. Held one point below full because the all-or-nothing property, when the default gate runs, is asserted on the query text rather than observed (see findings).
justifications.reuse: No capability is forked and the delta removes surface rather than adding it: compute_semantic_matches loses two unused parameters (target_ids_name, dd_version) that only the removed embedding arm had used, and its one caller (gather_shared_context) is updated; the section prompt reuses the same edge-dict accessor the map_signals consumer already applies instead of a second accessor.
justifications.scope_discipline: The delta touches exactly the six files the node permits: imas_codex/ids/graph_ops.py, imas_codex/ids/mapping.py, imas_codex/ids/tools.py, tests/ids/test_candidate_persistence.py, tests/ids/test_candidates.py and the landing fragment docs/evidence/fragments/mapping-candidate-selection/map-context-reads-candidates.html, all inside the node's declared write paths. No file outside the node's scope is edited, and the next node's retired fields are left untouched.
